Allowed origins: `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

Configured in `worker/src/index.ts`, in the CORS middleware (`app.use('*', cors({...}))`), specifically the `origin` callback function (lines ~20–29).

To add a new custom domain, edit that callback — add a check like `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'` or `origin.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')` inside the `if (...)` condition, returning `origin` when matched.
